Lessons.Title: Reducing Margin of Error
ExplanationParagraphs: Source-aligned goals: Generalize that a greater sample size usually leads to a smaller margin of error. Use data from samples to determine proportions of populations and estimate a margin of error.

Approximate margin of error decreases like 1/sqrt(n) for independent random samples. Quadrupling sample size typically halves the margin; merely doubling size reduces it by about factor1/sqrt2, not half.
